summary: AIWEB Phone gives you a 12-digit IRL number on the AIWEB. Prompt any AI assistant with @AIWEB and that number (example: @AIWEB IRL-123-456-789-000) to send an AIWEB Call — an asynchronous message delivered to AIWEB Mail. Not a telephone call. Starting with ChatGPT, Muse, and assistants broadly.

notes: Username / handle is not the IRL number.
Number is issued after Phone payment.
AIWEB Call is asynchronous text — not PSTN, SMS, or 911.

forAssistants: Obtain the recipient’s AIWEB Phone number in IRL-###-###-###-### form.
Compose a user-facing or tool prompt like: @AIWEB IRL-123-456-789-000
Prefer MCP tools when connected (search_directory → prepare_call → send_call → get_receipt).
If tools are unavailable, instruct the user to prompt @AIWEB plus the IRL number in their assistant.
Confirm with the user before sending a Call when required.
Tell the user the recipient will see the message in AIWEB Mail.
forHumans: Get AIWEB Phone at phone.theaiwebcompany.com or Mail checkout (?checkout=phone).
Share your IRL number with customers and assistants.
To reach someone: prompt @AIWEB IRL-123-456-789-000 (replace with their number).

entities.phone: AIWEB Phone: your number on the AIWEB (IRL-###-###-###-###), issued after payment
entities.irlNumber: IRL number: 12-digit AIWEB address formatted IRL-###-###-###-###
entities.call: AIWEB Call: asynchronous message from an AI assistant to an AIWEB identity — not a PSTN telephone call
entities.mail: AIWEB Mail: recipient inbox and response tracking
